# GHL Prime
> GHL Prime is a dedicated GoHighLevel expert team providing CRM setup, automation workflows, AI agents, vibe coding, and 24/7 white-label support for marketing agencies and SaaS founders. US-based, GHL-certified, fully white-labeled.

## Company
- [GHL Prime LLC](https://ghlprime.com): Legal name, founded 2024, HQ at 4801 Lang Ave NE, Suite 110, Albuquerque, NM 87109, USA. Email info@ghlprime.com, phone +1-505-207-5189
- [Octopi Digital](https://octopi-digital.com): Parent company

## What GHL Prime does
GHL Prime acts as the dedicated technical backend team for marketing agencies and SaaS founders who use GoHighLevel. Services include:
- GoHighLevel CRM setup and sub-account configuration
- Marketing automation workflow builds
- AI agent and voice receptionist deployment
- White-label SaaS Mode configuration and launch
- Vibe coding (AI-assisted custom development)
- 24/7 white-label client support
- API integrations and custom dashboards
- Team training and SOP documentation
